metadata.title: Strongly coupled piezoelectric cantilevers for broadband vibration energy harvesting

configuration.quote: The host structure of the proposed bio-inspired bi-stable piezoelectric energy harvester (BBPEH) is tailored from a cantilever beam

proof_mass.quote: The harvester consists of a piezoelectric macro fiber composite (MFC) transducer, a tip mass, and two sub-beams
proof_mass.section: A B S T R A C T

length_mm.quote: The active length and width of the piezoelectric MFC are 28 mm and 14 mm

width_mm.quote: The active length and width of the piezoelectric MFC are 28 mm and 14 mm

thickness_mm.quote: The thickness of the beam is 0.381 mm

type.quote: The dynamics of the proposed bio-inspired bi-stable piezoelectric energy harvester is investigated under sweeping frequency and harmonic excitations.
type.section: A B S T R A C T

frequency_Hz.quote: An average power output of 0.193 mW for a load resistance of 8.2 kΩ is harvested at the excitation frequency of 10 Hz and amplitude of 4.0 g.
frequency_Hz.section: A B S T R A C T

acceleration_g.quote: An average power output of 0.193 mW for a load resistance of 8.2 kΩ is harvested at the excitation frequency of 10 Hz and amplitude of 4.0 g.
acceleration_g.section: A B S T R A C T

motion_source.quote: the harvester was fixed on a VT-600 shaker providing base excitations.

load_resistance_ohm.quote: An average power output of 0.193 mW for a load resistance of 8.2 kΩ is harvested at the excitation frequency of 10 Hz and amplitude of 4.0 g.
load_resistance_ohm.section: A B S T R A C T

resonant_frequency_Hz.quote: The local vibration resonant frequency of the harvester was found to be ωn = 78.35 rad/s.

output_power_W.quote: The maximum power output is around 0.193 mW at the excitation of 10 Hz and 4.0 g.

bandwidth_Hz.quote: The frequency bandwidth of the interwell vibration becomes wider as the excitation level increases to 3.0 g and 4.0 g, to respectively cover 10.0 - 13.0 Hz and 9.5 - 13.5 Hz.
